system.description:
Ingenious. Chemistry is just healing with extra steps. The Alchemist trades explosions for elixirs, sharing potent brews with the whole party and keeping everyone standing through the ugliest of fights.

Weapon Kit Requirement. Engineers gain their first weapon kit at level 3. To take this subclass, an Engineer must learn either the Med Kit or the Elixir Gun.

LEVEL 3

Elixir Savant. You learn whichever of the Med Kit or Elixir Gun you don't already know, for free.

Shared Elixirs. Your Elixir Gadgets gain Reach 6 and can be thrown to grant an ally the elixir's benefit.

LEVEL 7

Enhanced Formula. All damage, temp HP and HP restored through your Med Kit, Elixir Gun, Healing Turret and Gadgets increases by 3.

LEVEL 11

Potent Concoction. Allies you grant temp HP also gain +INT Armor for its duration, and Stim Pack no longer applies Dazed.

LEVEL 15

Medical Dispersion Field. 1/Safe Rest, share your healing with all nearby allies for a minute.
